func (f *fleet) hostBootDescriptor(request EnsureRequest, imageID string) (hostboot.Descriptor, error) {
	return hostboot.Descriptor{
		SchemaVersion:            1,
		Cell:                     strings.ToLower(string(f.config.Region)),
		Region:                   string(f.config.Region),
		Node:                     hostNode(f.config, request.CreateKey),
		Owner:                    f.config.Owner,
		FleetGeneration:          f.config.Generation,
		CreateKey:                request.CreateKey,
		ImageID:                  imageID,
		DatabaseID:               request.BootPins.DatabaseID,
		PartitionID:              request.BootPins.PartitionID,
		SeatID:                   request.BootPins.SeatID,
		HostAttempt:              request.BootPins.HostAttempt,
		IntentGeneration:         request.PlacementGeneration,
		IntentPayloadDigest:      request.BootPins.IntentPayloadDigest,
		CanonicalRosterDigest:    request.BootPins.CanonicalRosterDigest,
		ManagedHostProfileDigest: request.PlacementProfileDigest,
		RuntimeManifestDigest:    request.BootPins.RuntimeManifestDigest,
	}, nil
}

func sameIntent(a, b OperationIntent) bool {
	return a.Action == b.Action && a.Key == b.Key && a.Region == b.Region && a.Generation == b.Generation &&
		a.Owner == b.Owner && a.ResourceID == b.ResourceID && a.CreateKey == b.CreateKey &&
		a.ExpectedETag == b.ExpectedETag && a.FaultDomain == b.FaultDomain && a.PrivateIP == b.PrivateIP && a.Shape == b.Shape &&
		a.WholeOCPUs == b.WholeOCPUs && a.MemoryInGBs == b.MemoryInGBs &&
		a.PlacementProfileDigest == b.PlacementProfileDigest && a.PlacementGeneration == b.PlacementGeneration &&
		a.ImageID == b.ImageID && a.BootDescriptor == b.BootDescriptor &&
		a.BootDescriptorSHA256 == b.BootDescriptorSHA256 &&
		a.VolumeID == b.VolumeID &&
		a.AvailabilityDomain == b.AvailabilityDomain && a.SizeGB == b.SizeGB && a.PreviousSizeGB == b.PreviousSizeGB &&
		a.Device == b.Device &&
		a.IsReadOnly == b.IsReadOnly && a.IsShareable == b.IsShareable &&
		a.IsPvEncryptionInTransitEnabled == b.IsPvEncryptionInTransitEnabled
}

func cloudInstance(instance core.Instance, etag string) CloudInstance {
	var ocpus, memoryInGBs *float32
	if instance.ShapeConfig != nil {
		ocpus = instance.ShapeConfig.Ocpus
		memoryInGBs = instance.ShapeConfig.MemoryInGBs
	}
	return CloudInstance{
		ID:                            stringValue(instance.Id),
		DisplayName:                   stringValue(instance.DisplayName),
		CompartmentID:                 stringValue(instance.CompartmentId),
		AvailabilityDomain:            stringValue(instance.AvailabilityDomain),
		FaultDomain:                   stringValue(instance.FaultDomain),
		Shape:                         stringValue(instance.Shape),
		Ocpus:                         ocpus,
		MemoryInGBs:                   memoryInGBs,
		LifecycleState:                string(instance.LifecycleState),
		ETag:                          etag,
		ImageID:                       stringValue(instance.ImageId),
		ConsistentVolumeNamingEnabled: consistentVolumeNamingEnabled(instance.LaunchOptions),
		Metadata:                      cloneStringMap(instance.Metadata),
		FreeformTags:                  cloneStringMap(instance.FreeformTags),
	}
}
